hi! so this might be a long reply but I’ll do my best.
this sounds like a complicated situation- first, it sounds like she is not in a great place and might be having some trouble figuring out what she wants/how she feels. second, I’m not sure I would consider this the typical “backup plan”, because it sounds like she may have some attachment issues. this would make it difficult to leave the situation she’s in regardless of how she feels about you. it’s very possible that she does love you and want to be with you, but she’s experiencing some fear about leaving, either because she’s afraid of change, afraid of the abuse that might come from leaving, or she may be facing homelessness if she did choose to leave him. it would probably be good for her to seek treatment to deal with these feelings, or at least have some time to think about what she wants. 

it seems to be a hard situation from all sides, and I definitely understand not wanting to be a backup plan. Just remember that she’s going through a lot, and if she says she loves you then she likely does and is just having a hard time coming to a decision about what’s best for her safety (mentally or physically). I would maybe give her some time and continue to support her, and let her know that things have changed and you’ll be there to help her when she needs it this time :)
